rank_and_shape_derivation_independently_.why_it_matters: This is the rule that makes structure components subtle, and a plausible-but-wrong shape expectation was the most likely defect in the packet. The reviewer was required to derive it from source rather than check the author's chain.
rank_and_shape_derivation_independently_.p2: 'The rank of a part-ref of the form part-name is the rank of part-name. The rank of a part-ref that has a section subscript list is the sum of the number of subscript triplets, the number of vector subscripts, and the sizes of one of the arrays in each multiple section subscript.'
rank_and_shape_derivation_independently_.C919: 'There shall not be more than one part-ref with nonzero rank.'
rank_and_shape_derivation_independently_.p3: 'The rank of a data-ref is the rank of the part-ref with nonzero rank, if any; otherwise, the rank is zero.'
rank_and_shape_derivation_independently_.consequence: array_parent%array_component is invalid when both part-refs have nonzero rank.
rank_and_shape_derivation_independently_.worked_case: For x(2:6:2)%alpha the triplet selects 2, 4 and 6 by 9.5.3.4.2 p3, so the extent is 3; 9.5.3.4.1 p2 gives the shape from the nonzero-rank part-ref; and 16.9.119 p5 fixes LBOUND at 1 - 'otherwise than the whole-array or nonzero whole-array DIM case, the result value is 1' - rather than inheriting the parent's lower bound. Required result: SHAPE=[3], LBOUND=[1], UBOUND=[3].
rank_and_shape_derivation_independently_.note: The LBOUND=1 detail is exactly the kind of thing that is easy to get backwards, and it was verified against 16.9.119 rather than assumed.

non_vacuity_by_mutation.principle: Non-vacuity must be proved by MUTATION targeting the FEATURE UNDER TEST. Oracle and input mutation alone is provably insufficient - a sibling packet's vacuity survived a 114-mutation campaign and was exposed only by mutating the feature.

feature_level_classes.component-reference: 24/24 fail - changing x%a to x%b is detected
feature_level_classes.parent-subscript: 13/13 fail - changing x(2)%c to x(3)%c is detected

non_vacuity_by_mutation.total: 371/371 failing mutations fail; 12/12 reverse mutations pass; the reviewer independently re-ran 52/52 feature mutations and confirmed all sensitive.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.why_distinct_values_matter: Every component AND every array element carries a distinct nonzero, nonblank value. Without that, the component-reference and parent-subscript mutations would be INVISIBLE - identical values make a mix-up undetectable. This was verified, not assumed.

findings.resolution: Integrator recorded an XFAIL. The author correctly did not modify tests/expected_failures.txt.

findings.issue: The advertised component-value-swap mutations mostly swap the common x(2)%alpha / x(2)%beta control values rather than each fixture's primary feature values, so the reported category counts overstate what those particular swaps exercise.
findings.why_not_blocking: The reviewer ran additional feature-local swaps of its own (obj%alpha/beta, obj%avec/bvec, obj%text/other_text) and all failed as required, so the fixtures are genuinely sensitive; only the labelling of the counts is imprecise.
findings.correction: Relabel or add feature-local swap metadata if those exact counts are to be relied upon. Recorded rather than blocked.

deferral_assessed.reason: Both toolchains reject the F2023 multiple-section-subscript @ syntax - gfortran with 'Expected array subscript', the frozen LFortran with a tokenizer error that @ is not recognized.
deferral_assessed.reviewer_verdict: Deferral is CORRECT. No non-@ alternative demonstrates this facet, so there is no way to establish it without the syntax. A toolchain limitation is not grounds to fabricate or weaken a test.
deferral_assessed.pending_facets: The 7 remaining pointer and subobject facets are implementable future work and were NOT claimed impossible - an unobservability claim that is too broad would itself be a defect.

oracle_discipline_verified.bounds: Array-valued component references assert SHAPE, LBOUND and UBOUND, not merely values, with non-unit and negative lower bounds such as [-5:-3] and distinct extents, so a defaulted, transposed or off-by-one bound is detectable.
oracle_discipline_verified.sentinels: No observed sentinel is 0, blank or .FALSE.; every observed component value is distinct.
oracle_discipline_verified.character: LEN is asserted for the credited rightmost-LEN cases. One same-length neighbour control lacks a separate LEN assertion but is not credited for any LEN claim.
oracle_discipline_verified.no_self_referential_intrinsic: No TRANSFER, LOC, address-based oracle or undefined read appears.
